description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
When Nether Traitor dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Pawn of Ulamog trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn token by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating another Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
